sources.limitations: Limited pick-your-own windows, rounded to whole months including partial months. Weather, cultivar and farm affect dates; other foods are not covered.

sources.organization: New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets
sources.limitations: Harvest and availability bars are distinct. Partial months count as whole months. Availability may include storage; do not infer fresh harvest from it. Weather and season extension shift dates. Calendar publication date is unstated; dates elsewhere in the toolkit do not date this chart.

sources.organization: California Department of Food and Agriculture (CA GROWN guest article)
sources.limitations: General statewide U-pick guide with examples from different districts, not a commercial production census. Availability varies by farm and cultivar. Apples and broad berry/citrus headings omitted pending clarification; no inference about storage.

sources.organization: Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
sources.limitations: Typical harvest times, not current inventory. Weather and greenhouse production can alter timing. Specific bell peppers, cantaloupe and oranges are not generalized to all peppers, melons or citrus.

Produce varieties and availability; does not distinguish field harvest, storage and protected production. Generic squash, greens, herbs, cabbage variants and greenhouse tomatoes are not generalized. State spans several climates.

AGR PUB 200-339 fruit, legume and herb availability chart. Asterisks mark peak harvest for apples and pears; other months may include storage. Unmarked bars are availability, not necessarily harvest. Frozen berries and dried beans excluded. Peach row covers yellow peaches and plum row covers purple plums only; other varieties are not established by these rows.

sources.organization: Michigan State University Center for Regional Food Systems
sources.limitations: Source landing page dates resource March 29, 2013; underlying observations are not dated. Field fresh, extended season and storage colors preserved. Partial months rounded outward; weather, locality and variety vary. Old reference needs periodic re-review, not relabelling as recent observations.

sources.organization: University of Georgia Cooperative Extension / Daniel Remar
sources.limitations: A means available; L means limited availability. General availability may reflect storage/season extension (source footnotes), not harvest. Geography and weather vary; no live inventory. Limited months are retained separately.
